edits.old: Then the payload carries no holder reference and no substitute reference
edits.new:
Then the payload carries no holder reference and no substitute reference

  Scenario: AC6 The business values, the personal fields and the checklist stay out of the code and the record (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given test user "U-3101" holds RW-COE with "CRUD" in "RULES_AND_PARAMETERS"
    When "U-3101" moves the L6 row of item 2.1.1 MORTGAGE with principalLimit 120,000,000.00 and validFrom 2027-01-01 and a reason
    Then the four amounts, the dates, the levels, the product groups and the decision codes come from rows with a version and no literal value is in the service code
    Then the record of the move carries references, codes, versions, amounts and times only, and the move carries its reason and approver with no checklist field

  Scenario: AC7 A call without a session is answered 401 and an unknown limit is answered 404 (new, D-RCV-60)
    When a caller without a session calls PATCH /api/recovery/access/v1/doa-limits/{delegationLimitId} for the L6 row of item 2.1.1 MORTGAGE
    Then the response is 401 and no row of delegation_limit is written
    When "U-3101" calls POST /api/recovery/access/v1/doa-limits/{delegationLimitId}/approve with a delegationLimitId that is not in the case
    Then the response is 404 and no approval entry is appended

  Scenario: AC8 A consumed call that fails or does not answer changes nothing (new, D-RCV-60)
    Given the rwb-case contract mock does not answer the parameter read
    When "U-3101" moves the L6 row of item 2.1.1 MORTGAGE with principalLimit 120,000,000.00 and validFrom 2027-01-01
    Then nothing changes, no row of delegation_limit is written and the user sees Not specified in the source documents (NEWAC-RWB-P4-E8008-APP-AC8)
